extension_note: No case required a new family, semantic rule or adapter to construct. The agent's own proposal collection (108 per-case proposals, 16 composed systems, 6 generators) consists of products constructible within existing families; it is not a set of catalogue extension proposals. The no_anchor entries are candidate proof-record additions, listed and not counted.
notes: All 54 sampled cases are data standards, interface specifications or data models hosted on GitHub, because the egress policy made GitHub the only readable primary-source host. The sample therefore exercises the catalogue's data-contract, identity, verification and change families heavily and the planning, allocation, routing, diagnosis, trade-off, simulation and physical-control families barely.
